author: Cleo Abram
description:
If we shrink down to the size of one of the tiniest particles in physics… 

We’d be able to zoom between the atoms of solid rock as easily as flying through the empty space between stars in our galaxy

They call them GHOST PARTICLES because they’re so small.

But how do you detect something that can GO RIGHT THROUGH any detector?

You build a very, very, large machine. To see that, subscribe!

#science #tech #space #physics #machine
title: GHOST PARTICLES Are Flying Through You
